title: Prose / Bullet Mix
description: A TR doc must MIX short paragraphs with bullets. Added after the reviewer's note that 'mostly all the content is bullets only, which looks odd' — and it did, because every earlier rule pushed the same way ('prefer bullets/tables over text'), so even pairs of short related points came back as lists. Two countable halves: at least 60% of slides must carry a `text` block (a short framing paragraph of <= 55 words / 2-3 sentences saying what the slide is about), and no bullet list may have fewer than 3 items, since a one- or two-item list is a sentence somebody bulleted. Bullets stay for genuine lists of 3+ parallel, substantial items; tables stay for any 2+ way comparison.
criterion: >= 60% of slides contain a `text` content block, AND every bullet list has >= 3 items.

rubric.5: Both hold: most slides open with a framing paragraph, every list is a real list.
rubric.3: One of the two is breached on a slide or two.
rubric.1: Wall-to-wall bullets, or several bulleted one/two-item 'lists'.

content.text: SCTP carries several independent streams inside one association, so a loss on one stream does not stall the others.

items: Each stream keeps its own sequence space
Loss blocks only the affected stream

cases.rationale: A framing paragraph, then a real 3-item list — the intended shape.
No framing paragraph, and a 2-item 'list' that is really one sentence.

input.doc_shape: 12 slides, 2 of which carry a `text` block

cases.rationale: 17% of slides carry prose — under the 60% floor; this is the wall of bullets the reviewer rejected.
